title: Venice, which develops identity security software, emerges from stealth after raising a $25M Series A led by IVP, following an $8M seed round (Meir Orbach/CTech)
summary: Meir Orbach / CTech: Venice, which develops identity security software, emerges from stealth after raising a $25M Series A led by IVP, following an $8M seed round — The Israeli company replaces static enterprise permissions with dynamic access control. — Startup Venice (formerly Valkyrie) has raised $25 million in a Series A funding round.
